text:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api p99 latency spike detected in us-west, request queue growth > 12k, GPU pool utilization 98% for 6m. tagging #oncall
matt_sre: seeing 502/504 timeouts in the frontend stack, p95 ~ 4.2s, p99 ~ 12.4s. queue depth trace: provisioner pending-create ~ 900, evictions ~ 0.
lia_prod: customers starting to report timeouts. which pool is the hot spot?
kevin_ml: ml-gpu-pool-uswest-3 is saturated. autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts failing with quota/instance-creation errors: `ErrQuotaExceeded` from cloud provider.
sara_support: I have an open ticket from Customer A getting HTTP 504 on requests intermittently, they're seeing failures for the last 8 minutes. escalated.
matt_sre: can we reroute traffic to other regions or fallback model variants? cost is secondary, need to restore availability.
kevin_ml: we have compatible cheaper variants in us-east and eu-west (gptx-quant-8), but routing policy requires manual override for this tenant.
lia_prod: start manual fallback for public API: change routing policy to prefer compat models and spill to us-east for non-low-latency tiers. @ops-oncall can you run the change?
ops-oncall: on it. patching route policy now: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/routing/override -d '{"match":"*",'prefer_regions':['us-east'],'allow_compat':true}'`
ops-oncall: patch applied, pushing to canary. monitor metrics. :eyes:
matt_sre: starting short term evictions for idle sessions in the queue: `POST /admin/queues/evict?age_gt=30s&target=50pct`
kevin_ml: autoscaler shows stuck reconcile loops because image-pull timeouts were high; provisioning new instances is failing intermittently. cloud console shows transient zone error in us-west-3.
lia_prod: can we throttle non-critical background requests and reduce batch sizes? that reduces per-token load.
ops-oncall: throttling rule applied to /embeddings and background evals for free-tier customers. live patch: `iptables` style token bucket applied at edge.
incident-bot: UPDATE: queue depth reduced from 12k -> 4.8k after routing + throttles, p99 down to ~6.7s but still elevated.
sara_support: notifying affected customers that we have partial degradation and are routing/falling back. drafting status update now.
matt_sre: we should also enable aggressive prefix caching for top request paths to cut token generation. kevin, can you flip cache TTL?
kevin_ml: bumped prefix cache TTL from 30s -> 2m for public routes. hoping to cutoff repeated warm prefixes.
lia_prod: cloud provider reports quota issue root cause: a regional maintenance caused delayed instance provisioning. engineering contacted provider; ETA 30m for resolution. we need long-tail plan if nodes don't come up.
ops-oncall: prepping warm pool in us-east, spinning up ded instances with reserve flag. starting `redeploy --pool=dedicated-us-east --count=6 --reserve=true`
incident-bot: PAGED: @matt_sre @ops-oncall oncall-rotation: night shift will take over at 22:00 UTC, handoff scheduled.
matt_sre: handing off to night team in 20m; summary: routing override live, throttles live, cache increased, eviction kicked, still awaiting provider fix. customer impact: intermittent timeouts for some customers; critical traffic routed to fallback models/regions.
sara_support: status message posted to status.redwood.ai: "Partial degradation in US-WEST hosted API; mitigations in place."
kevin_ml: plan B if provider doesn't recover: enforce wider fallback to quantized model family and drop non-essential logging to reduce load. will prepare feature flag.
lia_prod: logging note: keep tracing for a narrow set (10% sampling) so we can track residual errors without burning tokens.
ops-oncall: confirm last: queue ~4.2k, GPU pool 94% (downgraded), p95 ~2.8s, p99 ~6.9s. will watch 15m, then handoff.
matt_sre: thanks. if anything regresses ping pager immediately. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: night oncall acknowledged handoff at 1757773200.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: moved to mitigated state (partial). follow-up runbook: create postmortem, include provider incident id, customer list, and exact timeframe of degraded SLA.
lia_prod: assigning postmortem to @matt_sre and @kevin_ml. estimated impact window 2025-03-12T21:30:00Z -> ongoing until provider resolved.
sara_support: I'll compile impacted customer list and individual error traces for PM.
matt_sre: will attach log bundle and autoscaler reconcile traces.
ops-oncall: handing over. night team please verify analytics and customer pings in the morning.
night-oncall (DM): acknowledged, will follow up and reopen if queue growth restarts.
